authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8201 subsection 5 *pippīḍa explicitly gives Bengali pipiṛā, Assamese piparā and Hindi pipṛā ant. Eastern pipra/pepura forms match the labial-plus-r branch with contraction, vowels and deaspiration qualified; the isolated Bengali pipʼa records an apparent reduced rhotic and is not corrected. The entry warns of taboo variation and uncertain deeper origin; local transmission is unresolved. Exact response: pepura.
